/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from urllib.parse import urlencode
from urllib.request import Request,urlopen
seq=''
data=urlencode({'CMD':'Put','PROGRAM':'blastp','DATABASE':'refseq_protein','QUERY':seq,'ENTREZ_QUERY':'Homo sapiens[organism]','EXPECT':'1e-5','HITLIST_SIZE':'10'}).encode()
req=Request('https://blast.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/Blast.cgi',data=data,headers={'User-Agent':'Codex sequence annotation task'})
print(urlopen(req,timeout=60).read().decode())
PY"
